picks.headline: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 can control a humanoid robot's entire body
picks.excerpt: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a model that adds intelligent whole-body control so a humanoid robot can coordinate its arms, torso and base together -- tying up trash bags, unscrewing lightbulbs and handling multi-step chores. A concrete step toward general-purpose embodied AI in consumer-facing home robots.
picks.rationale: Highest novelty + credibility: a new foundation-model release that unlocks whole-body embodied control, the frontier of consumer home robots -- and the strongest fresh cluster not yet in gadgets history.

picks.headline: OpenAI's first device is a screenless, movable AI companion speaker -- with a smartphone to follow
picks.excerpt: OpenAI's hardware roadmap has sharpened: its first product is a portable, screenless smart speaker built with former Apple design chief Jony Ive as an at-home AI companion, with a camera to understand its surroundings and a smartphone reportedly arriving as soon as next year. A design-led rethink of what an AI-native home device looks like.
picks.rationale: Design-led product reveal (Jony Ive, screenless companion) that reframes what an AI-native home device looks like -- top-tier novelty for a designer audience, distinct companion-device cluster.

picks.headline: Exploring Apple Silicon's local AI performance with the Mac Studio and M4 Max
picks.excerpt: A hands-on benchmark of on-device LLM performance across Apple's M4 Max, NVIDIA's GB10 and AMD Strix Halo, finding the M4 Max leads on decode throughput while memory bandwidth alone doesn't decide the winner. A concrete look at which consumer hardware actually runs local AI well for creative and dev workloads.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability: a hands-on benchmark telling designers/devs which hardware actually runs local AI best -- changes purchase and workflow decisions tomorrow. Distinct edge-silicon cluster.

picks.headline: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P review: the gimbal camera goes pro with dual lenses
picks.excerpt: DJI's pocket gimbal camera goes 'pro' with two lenses, optical zoom, class-leading dynamic range and AI subject tracking. A creator-focused standalone AI camera that reshapes how solo shooters capture and follow subjects on the move.
picks.rationale: Actionable creator tool with a full hands-on review: AI subject tracking + dual lenses reshape how solo shooters capture -- the standalone AI-camera pick, chosen over the Insta360 interview to keep the cluster single.

picks.headline: Halliday G2: camera-free smart glasses bring heads-up meeting AI
picks.excerpt: The Halliday G2 skips the camera and instead leans on binocular micro-LED displays and a 'Meeting Flow' AI that delivers live translation, captioning, research lookups and post-meeting transcripts in a sub-50g frame. A privacy-forward take on how AI eyewear can assist without recording everyone around you.
picks.rationale: Actual shipping product (not an event teaser) with a distinct privacy-forward, camera-free design angle -- adds the 5th outlet and the smart-glasses cluster, chosen over Snap's teaser to give 5 distinct outlets and 5 distinct categories.
